composition: Circular Munot fortress above the Schaffhausen roofs and the Rhine · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The Munot stands on the Emmersberg above Schaffhausen as a circular stone roundel with a round tower and a steep roof, old-town roofs and a bend of the Rhine below the rock. This is the town fortress, not the Rhine Falls, so there is no cataract and no Schloss Laufen. No new scaffolding is added. The Open-Meteo model sets the afternoon light.
